senses.gloss:
Knob,Ⓒs.ⒹpiMqaH, gaMqaH; graMTiH, parvan n., saMDiH (in wood).
Ⓝ[Knob]bed, [Knob]by,Ⓒa.ⒹsapiMqa, piMqin, graMTila, sagaMqa.

Knock,Ⓒv. t.ⒹsamA-A-han 2 U, taq 10, prahf 1 P; ‘k(nock) on the head’ mastakaM taq, masta-kAGAtena vyApad c.; (fig.) moGIkf 8 U, viPalIkf, BaMj 7 P.
Ⓔv. i.ⒹdvAraM taq or prahf.
Ⓔs.ⒹAGAtaH, aBiGAtaH, prahAraH, tAqanaM, pAtaH, hati f.; ‘k(nock) with a stick’ vetrAGAtaH; ‘k(nock) with the fist’ muzwiGAtaH-prahAraH.
Ⓝ[Knock] against,ⒶaBi-prati-A-han, saMGawwa 1 A, aBisaM-pat 1 P; ‘k(nock)ed her head against a rock’ dfzadaM SIrzeRa AjaGne.
Ⓝ[Knock] down,Ⓐni-ava-pat c., AGAtena-prahAreRa-nipat c. or BraMS c.
Ⓝ[Knock] off,ⒶsatvaraM-laGu-saMpad c. or sAD 5 P.
Ⓑ
 2 viram 1 P, nivft 1 A.
Ⓝ[Knock] out,ⒶprahAreRa nirgam c. (gamayati) or niHsf c. or bahizkf 8 U; ‘k(nock) out the brains’ mastizkaM nizpiz 7 P.
Ⓝ[Knock] up,ⒶKid c., Ayas c., avasad c., Sram c. or klam c. (Sra-kla-mayati); (v. i.) Sram 4 P, klam 1, 4 P, Kid pass., avasad 1 P, glE-mlE 1 P; ‘k(nock)ed up by the journey’ aDvasaMjAtaKedaH, nitAMtaM pariSrAMtaH.
Ⓝ[Knock]er,Ⓒs.Ⓓprahartf m., tAqayitf m.
Ⓑ
 2 dvAramudgaraH, dvAratAqanI.

Knoll,Ⓒv. i.ⒹGaMwAM vad c. or taq 10.
Ⓔs.Ⓓkzudra-parvataH, unnataBUBAgaH, vapraH-praM.

Knot,Ⓒs.ⒹgraMTiH, baMDanaM, graMTikA, baMDaH, gaMqaH; (of garments) nIvi-vI f.; (in wood) parvan n., saMDiH.
Ⓑ
 2 saMDiH, saMyogaH, saMSlezaH, saMbaMDaH.
Ⓑ
 3 maMqalaM, samUhaH, gaRaH, vargaH, saMGaH, cakraM^1, nivahaH.
Ⓑ
 4 (Of trees) zaMqaH, gucCaH, stabakaH, gulmaH-lmaM, staMbaH, kAMqaH.
Ⓔv. t.ⒹgraMTiM baMD 9 P, graMT 9 P, saMSliz c., ‘k(nott)ed hair’ veRI; ‘k(nott)ed wound’ rUQagraMTiH vraRaH (U. 2).
Ⓝ[Knot]ted, [Knot]ty,Ⓒa.ⒹgraMTila, graMTimat, parva-saMDi-maya (yI f.), parvavat.
Ⓑ
 2 vizama, gUQa, durjYeya, durboDa, gahana, gUQArTa; ‘k(notty) point’ graMTiH, vizamapadaM.

Know,Ⓒv. t.ⒹjYA 9 U, vid 2 P, buD 1 P, avagam 1 P, ava-i 2 P, aBijYA, paricita a. BU 1 P.
Ⓑ
 2 anu-BU, vi-BU c., upalaB 1 A, grah 9 U; ‘how should a dependent k(now) of sincere happiness (pleasure)’ parAyattaH prIteH kaTamiva rasaM vettu puruzaH (Mu. 3).
Ⓝ[Know]er,Ⓒs.ⒹjYatf m., jYAnin m., vetf m. jYaH-aBijYaH in comp.
Ⓝ[Know]ing,Ⓒa.ⒹvijYa, jYAnin; gen. ex. by vid, jYa or aBijYa in comp.; ‘k(nowing) Dharma’ Darmavid, DarmajYaH.
Ⓝ[Know]ingly,Ⓒadv.ⒹjYAnapUrvaM, kAmataH, boDa-mati-budDi-pUrvaM, jAnat a. with api.
Ⓝ[Know]ledge,Ⓒs.Ⓓ(Act) jYAnaM, pari-vi-jYAnaM, boDaH-DanaM, vedanaM, avagamaH, upalaMBaH, upalabDi f.
Ⓑ
 2 (Learning) jYAnaM, vidyA, vidvattA, pAMqityaM, vyutpannatA, vEduzyaM.
Ⓑ
 3 aBijYAnaM, paricayaH; ‘spiritual k(nowledge)’ AtmajYAnaM-vidyA, paramArTajYAnaM, aDyAtmavidyA, paramArTaH, brahmavidyA, paramArTaboDaH; ‘acquiring k(nowledge)’ vidyArjanaM, vidyAgamaH, jYAnaprApti f.; ‘eager after k(nowledge)’ jYAnecCu, jijYAsu; ‘thirst after k(nowledge)’ jijYA-sA, jYAnalipsA, jYAnecCA; ‘according to oneʼs k(nowledge)’ yaTAjYAnaM; ‘for the right k(nowledge) of words and their meaning’ vAgarTapratipattaye (R. i. 1); ‘without the k(nowledge) of’ avijYApya, anivedya, agocaraM-reRa, parokzaM-kze; ‘with the k(nowledge) of’ gocaraM-reRa, pratyakzaM, sAkzAt, samakzaM; ‘to come to the k(nowledge) of’ Sruti-karRa-paTaM yA-i- 2 P or gam 1 P; ‘k(nowledge) is power’ budDiryasya balaM tasya (P. i. 8).
ⓃKnown,Ⓒa.ⒹjYAta, vidita, avagata, boDita, upalabDa, anuBUta, viBAvita.
Ⓑ
 2 KyAta, vi-Sruta, prasidDa, vi-pra-KyAta, vijYAta; ‘to make k(nown)’ vi-jYA c. (jYApayati), ni-A-vid c., buD c., ‘to become k(nown)’ jYA-prati-i pass.; ‘be it k(nowledge) to your honor’ eva-matraBavaMto vidAMkurvaMtu; ‘be it k(nown)’ jYAtaM-viditaM-astu; ‘became k(nowledge) by that name’ tadAKyayA (Buvi) papraTe (R. xv. 101), tadA-KyAM jagAma.
